final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.zoneref AS z, s.entrystat AS st, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS ga FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.z, g.st, g.ga, g.ga - o.oa AS dov FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL), sg AS (SELECT st, AVG(ga) AS sa FROM p GROUP BY st), k AS (SELECT p.ga, p.dov, p.ga - sg.sa AS dst FROM p JOIN sg ON sg.st = p.st COLLATE BINARY WHERE p.ga > sg.sa) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(dov) AS avg_diff_overall, AVG(dst) AS avg_diff_status FROM k
